classification_and_limits: No net is SELV. Output voltage does not remove shock risk. Functional spacing between live nets is different from protective insulation to touchable surfaces.
Dry indoor laboratory, no condensation or conductive contamination, altitude<=2000m are explicit proposed operating restrictions. Board clean after assembly; no assumed conformal coating.

Do not claim PD1 simply because board is indoors. Use PD2 as a review assumption and require actual microenvironment/CTI confirmation before normative claims. FR4 is not an exact CTI/material-group declaration.

All numeric spacings below are engineering CAD targets for bounded lab prototype. They are NOT extracted minimum distances from an applicable lamp standard; no access to full current normative tables.
Soldermask receives zero credit as protective or creepage-reducing insulation. No slots, coating or 1.6mm FR4 assigned a protective safety rating without actual system evidence.
400V normal waveform screen does not establish any IEC surge level. MOV clamping, pulse currents, inductor ringing and device peak voltages need actual tests before declaring operation.
Prototype may be drawn/assembled unpowered using this research only after owner/toolkit stage decisions. No manufacture, energizing or compliance approval follows from this report.
